lines.text_en: What brings you here all of a sudden?

lines.text_ko: 최정요, 솔직히 말해 봐. 너 비오한테 일부러 그러는 거지.
lines.text_en: Choi Jung-yo, tell me honestly. You're doing this to Bi-o on purpose, right?
What do you mean, on purpose?

lines.text_ko: 너 비오가 네 납치에 관련 있단 소문 듣고 이러는 거잖아.
lines.text_en: You're acting like this because you heard rumors that Bi-o was involved in your kidnapping.

lines.text_ko: 그런 거면 당장 접어, 절대 아니니까.
lines.text_en: If that's it, drop it right now, because it's definitely not true.
How can you be so sure of that?
So it is true, that's why you acted like that.

lines.text_ko: 나 너희들 옛날부터 누구보다 가까이서 지켜본 사람이야.
lines.text_en: I'm someone who has watched you guys closer than anyone else since the old days.

lines.text_ko: 지금까지 비오는 사람들 다 포기했을 때도 혼자 유럽을 샅샅이 뒤져가면서 널 찾아다녔어.
lines.text_en: Until now, even when everyone else gave up, Bi-o searched all over Europe alone looking for you.

lines.text_ko: 근데 너는 어떻게 그런 친구를 그깟 소문 때문에 오해를 할 수가 있어?
lines.text_en: Yet how could you misunderstand such a friend over a mere rumor?

lines.text_ko: 그건 날 찾아다닌 게 아니라 내 죽음을 확인하고 싶어서라고 생각할 수도 있지 않을까요?
lines.text_en: Couldn't one think that he wasn't looking for me, but rather wanted to confirm my death?
Choi Jung-yo, I'm really disappointed in you.
